t: A free web portal with about 700 lessons for Ozobot robots.
steps: Go to classroom.ozobot.com and create a free teacher account.
Browse the lessons by grade and subject.
Open the Ozobot Simulator to test a lesson without a robot.
Check that you have Ozobot Evo or Bit robots for the lessons you pick.
Use the pacing guide for your grade.
Students do not log in. Skip student accounts.
